result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.attribute_mixing_dict()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count edges by the attribute values of their two endpoints. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L28671-L28720){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.attribute_mixing_dict( attribute, normalized=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Attribute mixing dict](/assets/graphs/attribute-mixing-dict.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Two triangles joined by one edge, with team x on A, B, C (teal) and team y on D, E, F (violet). Each triangle's three edges count from both ends, 6 within each team, and the one accent edge C–D links x to y once each way: {x: {x: 6, y: 1}, y: {x: 1, y: 6}}." width="100%"} For every pair of values `(a, b)` of a categorical node attribute, how many edges run from a node with value `a` to a node with value `b`. This is the basis of homophily analysis: in a friendship network split by school year or party, most edges stay within a group if like links with like. Undirected edges count from both ends (so the table is symmetric); directed edges count once, source value first. See `attribute_mixing_matrix()` for a matrix and `get_assortativity_nominal()` for the single-number summary. Matches NetworkX's `attribute_mixing_dict()`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [attribute]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Name of the node attribute. Every node must have a value. [normalized]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return fractions of all counted edge ends instead of counts. Default is `False`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A nested dictionary `{a: {b: count}}`. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If some node has no value for the attribute. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Two teams with one friendship across them: ::: {#5f5de52a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("C", "D"), ("B", "C")]) ) graph.set_node_attrs("team", {1: "red", 2: "red", 3: "blue", 4: "blue"}) graph.attribute_mixing_dict("team") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'red': {'red': 2, 'blue': 1}, 'blue': {'blue': 2, 'red': 1}} ``` ::: :::
